source: Owner Chartink scans (screenshots in config/strategies/ChartInk, 2026-11-20). DRAFT - not loaded until approved; then moved to config/strategies/library/owner/.

strategies.name: Daily EMA 9 crosses above EMA 45
strategies.entry: cross_above(ema(close, 9), ema(close, 45))

strategies.name: Daily EMA 9 crosses above EMA 200
strategies.entry: cross_above(ema(close, 9), ema(close, 200))

strategies.name: MACD turning up from below zero with RSI(3) >= 80
strategies.entry: (cross_above(macd(close), macd_signal(close)) or macd_hist(close) >= 0) and (macd(close) <= 0 or macd_signal(close) <= 0) and rsi(close, 3) >= 80

strategies.name: MACD crosses above signal below zero
strategies.entry: cross_above(macd(close), macd_signal(close)) and macd(close) < 0
strategies.notes: daily (200648) and weekly (202041) scans merged: same rule, two timeframes

strategies.name: Monthly MACD crosses above signal below zero (fires on the first day after the month closes)
strategies.entry: cross_above(htf(macd(close), "1mo"), htf(macd_signal(close), "1mo")) and htf(macd(close), "1mo") < 0

strategies.name: Entry A - MACD reversal below zero in an uptrend
strategies.entry: cross_above(macd(close), macd_signal(close)) and macd(close) < 0 and close > ema(close, 200) and close > ema(close, 50) and close > ema(close, 21)
strategies.notes: market cap > 3000 cr not applied (no market-cap data)

strategies.name: Predictive MACD: histogram rising 3 days below zero in an uptrend
strategies.entry: close > ema(close, 200) and close > ema(close, 50) and macd_hist(close) < 0 and macd_hist(close) > macd_hist(close)[1] and macd_hist(close)[1] > macd_hist(close)[2] and macd_hist(close)[2] > macd_hist(close)[3] and close > close[1] and close[1] > close[2] and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20) and rsi(close, 14) > rsi(close, 14)[1] and between(rsi(close, 14), 40, 55)
strategies.notes: market cap > 5000 cr not applied (no market-cap data)

strategies.name: 5 days in a row, each close >= 4.9% above the previous
strategies.entry: all_of(close >= 1.049 * close[1], 5)

strategies.name: 5 higher closes in a row
strategies.entry: all_of(close > close[1], 5)

strategies.name: 3 rising closes + yesterday RSI(3) > 80 + EMA 20 reclaim or EMA13 > EMA20 + volume >= 2x
strategies.entry: close > close[1] and close[1] > close[2] and close[2] > close[3] and rsi(close, 3)[1] > 80 and ((close > ema(close, 20) and open < ema(close, 20)) or ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20)) and volume >= 2 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: 2 closes above prior highs + RSI(3) > 80 + EMA 20 clause + volume >= 2x
strategies.entry: close[1] > high[2] and close > high[1] and rsi(close, 3) > 80 and ((close > ema(close, 20) and open < ema(close, 20)) or ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20)) and volume >= 2 * sma(volume, 20)
strategies.notes: near-duplicate of O2-010 (highs instead of closes); kept as a variant

strategies.name: SHORT: 3 falling closes and lows + yesterday RSI(3) < 20 + EMA 20 break or EMA13 < EMA20 + volume >= 2x
strategies.entry: close[2] < close[3] and close[1] < close[2] and low[1] < low[2] and close < close[1] and low < low[1] and rsi(close, 3)[1] < 20 and ((close < ema(close, 20) and open > ema(close, 20)) or ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 20)) and volume >= 2 * sma(volume, 20)
strategies.notes: mirror of O2-010

strategies.name: 15m: close above previous high, two green bars, RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: close > high[1] and close > open and close[1] > open[1] and rsi(close, 3) > 80

strategies.name: 5m: EMA 4 > 9 > 18, green bar, higher close, daily RSI(3) > 75
strategies.entry: ema(close, 4) > ema(close, 9) and ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 18) and close > open and close > close[1] and htf(rsi(close, 3), "1d") > 75

strategies.name: 5m (from 3m): two rising closes, daily volume > 125000, daily RSI(3) > 79
strategies.entry: close > close[1] and close[1] > close[2] and htf(volume, "1d") > 125000 and htf(rsi(close, 3), "1d") > 79

strategies.name: 15m: 5% candle on 1.5x volume (up)
strategies.entry: volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 10) and close > 1.05 * close[1]

strategies.name: SHORT: 15m 5% candle on 1.5x volume (down)
strategies.entry: volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 10) and close < 0.95 * close[1]
strategies.notes: scan returns both up and down 5% bars; drafted short pending owner answer

strategies.name: Volume > 2x the highest volume of the previous 15 days (green day)
strategies.entry: volume > 2 * highest(volume, 15)[1] and close > open
strategies.notes: scan has no direction; drafted long on a green day pending owner answer

strategies.name: Yesterday: very low volume (< half EMA 20) with RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: volume[1] < ema(volume, 20)[1] / 2 and rsi(close, 3)[1] > 80

strategies.name: EMA 9 > EMA 20 and EMA 9 rising steeply (slope vs day range > 45%)
strategies.entry: ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 20) and (ema(close, 9) - ema(close, 9)[1]) * 100 > 45 * (high - low)
strategies.notes: Chartink name '9 GT 20 AT 45 DEG'

strategies.name: 15m: candle reclaims EMA 50 in a downtrend (EMA13 < 50 < 200), daily EMA13 within 10% of EMA50
strategies.entry: ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) and open < ema(close, 50) and close >= ema(close, 50) and (htf(ema(close, 50), "1d") - htf(ema(close, 13), "1d")) <= 0.1 * htf(ema(close, 50), "1d")

strategies.name: 15m: previous bar reclaimed EMA 50 in a downtrend, current bar closes higher (3m confirmation mapped to 15m)
strategies.entry: ema(close, 13)[1] < ema(close, 50)[1] and ema(close, 50)[1] < ema(close, 200)[1] and open[1] < ema(close, 50)[1] and close[1] >= ema(close, 50)[1] and close > close[1]
strategies.notes: variant of O2-021

strategies.name: Candle reclaims EMA 50 in a downtrend (EMA13 < 50 < 200)
strategies.entry: ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) and close > ema(close, 50) and open < ema(close, 50)
strategies.notes: daily scan; same idea as O2-021 so also run on 60m/15m

strategies.name: Heikin-Ashi close crosses above EMA 50 in a downtrend
strategies.entry: ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) and cross_above(ha_close, ema(close, 50))

strategies.name: SHORT: 15m red candle cuts EMA 50 down (EMA13 crossed below 50, or daily EMA13 > 50)
strategies.entry: (cross_below(ema(close, 13), ema(close, 50)) or htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 50), "1d")) and close < ema(close, 50) and open > ema(close, 50)
strategies.notes: could be a buy-the-dip in a daily uptrend; drafted short pending owner answer

strategies.name: SHORT: EMA 13 crosses below EMA n with close below it (mirror of O1-001..004)
strategies.entry: cross_below(ema(close, 13), ema(close, $n)) and close < ema(close, $n)

strategies.name: 30m: EMA 100 crosses above EMA 200, EMA 200 >= EMA 400, EMAs within 5%
strategies.entry: cross_above(ema(close, 100), ema(close, 200)) and ema(close, 200) >= ema(close, 400) and ((ema(close, 200) - ema(close, 400)) <= 0.05 * ema(close, 200) or (ema(close, 100) - ema(close, 200)) <= 0.05 * ema(close, 100))

strategies.name: 1h + daily bull stack (13 > 20 > 100), 1h volume up, breaks yesterday's high
strategies.entry: ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 100) and htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") and volume > sma(volume, 20) and high >= prev_day_high()

strategies.name: SHORT: 1h + daily bear stack (13 < 20 < 100), 1h volume up, breaks yesterday's low
strategies.entry: ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) < ema(close, 100) and htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") and volume > sma(volume, 20) and low < prev_day_low()
strategies.notes: mirror of O2-028

strategies.name: 5m (from 3m) + 15m bull stack 13 > 20 > 50 > 100, open = low, breakout bar, RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) > ema(close, 100) and htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") and close > open and open == low and close[1] > open[1] and close > high[1] and low > low[1] and rsi(close, 3) > 80

strategies.name: SHORT: 5m (from 3m) + 15m bear stack 100 > 20 > 13, volume up, new day low
strategies.entry: ema(close, 100) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 13) and htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") and volume > sma(volume, 20) and low <= session_low

strategies.name: Below EMA 200 recovery: 2 higher closes, above EMA 13, RSI(300) >= 49, volume up
strategies.entry: close < ema(close, 200) and close > close[1] and close > close[2] and close > ema(close, 13) and rsi(close, 300) >= 49 and volume > sma(volume, 20)
strategies.notes: daily (201400) and weekly (202020) merged; monthly version (202010) needs a 200-month EMA (~17 years) - not possible with our history

strategies.name: Candle crosses SMA 20 from below and pierces the upper Bollinger band; daily, weekly, monthly RSI >= 59
strategies.entry: high > bb_upper(close, 20, 2) and close >= sma(close, 20) and open <= sma(close, 20) and rsi(close, 14) >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1w") >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1mo") >= 59

strategies.name: Follow-through day after an SMA 20 cross; daily, weekly, monthly RSI >= 59
strategies.entry: close >= close[1] and close[1] >= sma(close, 20)[1] and open[1] <= sma(close, 20)[1] and rsi(close, 14) >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1w") >= 59 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1mo") >= 59
strategies.notes: branches 2 and 3 of the scan (high above / below upper band) merged

strategies.name: 1h: tight 20-bar base (low within 5% of SMA 20), close above the highest upper band, RSI(3) > 80
strategies.entry: rsi(close, 3) > 80 and (sma(close, 20) - lowest(low, 20)) < 0.05 * sma(close, 20) and close > highest(bb_upper(close, 20, 2), 20)

strategies.name: Monthly RSI(3) < 20 (deeply oversold) + 2 up days
strategies.entry: htf(rsi(close, 3), "1mo") < 20 and close[1] > close[2] and close > close[1]

strategies.name: SHORT: 1h divergence - price above a bar 1-5 back while RSI(14) is lower, RSI >= 60
strategies.entry: rsi(close, 14) >= 60 and ((close > close[1] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[1]) or (close > close[2] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[2]) or (close > close[3] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[3]) or (close > close[4] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[4]) or (close > close[5] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[5]))
strategies.notes: higher price + lower RSI is classically bearish divergence; drafted short pending owner answer

strategies.name: Daily green hammer (lower wick >= 2x body and >= 1.75x upper wick)
strategies.entry: close > open and (open - low) >= 2 * (close - open) and (open - low) >= 1.75 * (high - close)

strategies.name: Hammer (green or red) that makes a lower low
strategies.entry: ((close > open and (open - low) >= 2 * (close - open) and (open - low) >= 1.75 * (high - close)) or (close < open and (close - low) >= 2 * (open - close) and (close - low) >= 1.75 * (high - open))) and low < low[1]

strategies.name: Hammer 2 days ago, confirmed: yesterday closes above its high, today higher close
strategies.entry: ((close[2] < open[2] and (close[2] - low[2]) >= 2 * (open[2] - close[2]) and (close[2] - low[2]) >= 1.75 * (high[2] - open[2])) or (close[2] > open[2] and (open[2] - low[2]) >= 2 * (close[2] - open[2]) and (open[2] - low[2]) >= 1.75 * (high[2] - close[2]))) and (min(open[1], close[1]) - low[1]) >= 1.75 * (high[1] - max(open[1], close[1])) and close[1] > high[2] and close > close[1]

strategies.name: SHORT: shooting star after 2 green days, gap-up open fails
strategies.entry: close < open and (high - open) >= 2 * (open - close) and (high - open) >= 1.75 * (close - low) and close[1] > open[1] and close[2] > open[2] and close < close[1] and open > close[1]
strategies.notes: original scan can never fire (branch A: '3 days ago close > 3 days ago close'; branch B: close > open and open > close). Drafted as the evident intent - confirm

strategies.name: 5 red 5m candles in a row
strategies.entry: all_of(close < open, 5)
strategies.notes: drafted long (exhaustion bounce) pending owner answer

strategies.name: 5 green 5m candles in a row
strategies.entry: all_of(close > open, 5)
strategies.notes: drafted long (momentum) pending owner answer

strategies.name: SHORT: strong prior day stalls, 15m bar turns red and breaks the previous bar's low
strategies.entry: prev_day_high() > prev_day_high(2) and session_high < prev_day_high() and low[1] > ema(close, 5)[1] and low < low[1] and open > close
strategies.notes: approximation: daily volume > SMA20 and yesterday's upper wick/body < 5 dropped. Could be a short or a pullback entry - pending owner answer

strategies.name: SHORT: 15m Supertrend(4,2) flipped bearish on the previous bar, lower close
strategies.entry: supertrend_dir(4, 2)[1] < 0 and supertrend_dir(4, 2)[2] > 0 and close < close[1]

strategies.name: 15m Supertrend(4,2) flips bullish, RSI(3) > 80, two green Heikin-Ashi bars rising
strategies.entry: supertrend_dir(4, 2) > 0 and supertrend_dir(4, 2)[1] < 0 and rsi(close, 3) > 80 and ha_close > ha_open and ha_close[1] > ha_open[1] and ha_close > ha_close[1]

strategies.name: Daily candle touches EMA 44 of lows
strategies.entry: high > ema(low, 44) and low <= ema(low, 44)

strategies.name: Daily candle touches EMA 44 of highs
strategies.entry: high > ema(high, 44) and low <= ema(high, 44)

strategies.name: Entry B - trend continuation pullback to EMA 21
strategies.entry: close > ema(close, 200) and ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 21) and ema(close, 21) > ema(close, 50) and close > ema(close, 9) and low <= 1.02 * ema(close, 21) and low >= 0.97 * ema(close, 21) and macd_hist(close) > 0 and between(rsi(close, 14), 45, 62) and volume < 1.2 * sma(volume, 20) and volume * close > 100000000 and close > 0.97 * close[1]
strategies.notes: market cap > 2000 cr not applied (no market-cap data); turnover > 10 cr kept

strategies.name: Close crosses above EMA 200
strategies.entry: cross_above(close, ema(close, 200))

strategies.name: SHORT: Close crosses below EMA 200
strategies.entry: cross_below(close, ema(close, 200))

strategies.name: Near EMA 200 (within 1%)
strategies.entry: abs(close / ema(close, 200) - 1) <= $b
strategies.notes: 200943 is the same idea at 2%, but its 'any of' makes it match every stock (bug)

strategies.name: 15m squeeze: Bollinger width <= 2x ATR
strategies.entry: bb_upper(close, 20, 2) - bb_lower(close, 20, 2) <= 2 * atr(14)

strategies.name: 1h EMA 20/50/100/200 all within 1%, daily close above EMA 50, weekly close above EMA 21
strategies.entry: (max(ema(close, 20), ema(close, 50), ema(close, 100), ema(close, 200)) - min(ema(close, 20), ema(close, 50), ema(close, 100), ema(close, 200))) < 0.01 * close and htf(close, "1d") > htf(ema(close, 50), "1d") and htf(close, "1w") > htf(ema(close, 21), "1w")

strategies.name: Monthly and weekly RSI(14) >= 60, daily RSI(14) >= 40
strategies.entry: htf(rsi(close, 14), "1mo") >= 60 and htf(rsi(close, 14), "1w") >= 60 and rsi(close, 14) >= 40

strategies.name: Full bull EMA stack 9>13>20>50>100>200 on 5m, 15m, 1h and daily
strategies.entry: ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 13) and ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) > ema(close, 100) and ema(close, 100) > ema(close, 200) and htf(ema(close, 9), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") > htf(ema(close, 200), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 9), "60m") > htf(ema(close, 13), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 13), "60m") > htf(ema(close, 20), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "60m") > htf(ema(close, 50), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 50), "60m") > htf(ema(close, 100), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 100), "60m") > htf(ema(close, 200), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 9), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 50), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 50), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") > htf(ema(close, 200), "1d")
strategies.notes: scan compares 1h EMA100 with 15m EMA200 (typo) - drafted as 1h EMA100 > 1h EMA200

strategies.name: SHORT: Full bear EMA stack 9<13<20<50<100<200 on 5m, 15m, 1h and daily
strategies.entry: ema(close, 9) < ema(close, 13) and ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) < ema(close, 50) and ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 100) and ema(close, 100) < ema(close, 200) and htf(ema(close, 9), "15m") < htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 13), "15m") < htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "15m") < htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 50), "15m") < htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 100), "15m") < htf(ema(close, 200), "15m") and htf(ema(close, 9), "60m") < htf(ema(close, 13), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 13), "60m") < htf(ema(close, 20), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 20), "60m") < htf(ema(close, 50), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 50), "60m") < htf(ema(close, 100), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 100), "60m") < htf(ema(close, 200), "60m") and htf(ema(close, 9), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 13), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 20), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 50), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 50), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") and htf(ema(close, 100), "1d") < htf(ema(close, 200), "1d")
strategies.notes: same 1h/15m typo fixed
